highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: If you’re looking for a university that gives you academic excellence with a welcoming community, Southern Utah University (SUU) is a good choice. The university offers you over 140 undergraduate and around 20 graduate programs across fields like business, aviation, performing arts, and the sciences.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: SUU offers a vibrant campus life where you can engage in a variety of activities, with over 130 student clubs and organisations. The university also offers counselling and psychological services, and virtual mental health support as well.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
At Southern Utah University (SUU), you have a variety of on-campus housing options designed to suit your preferences. You can choose from en-suite and apartment options, each with all the amenities you need.

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
The Gerald R. Sherratt Library on campus is your best place for studying and research. You can benefit from 3 floors of facilities and study rooms.

Sports
SUU has a lot of sports facilities to keep you active. You’ll find the George S. Eccles Sports Performance Centre, which is an 8,000 square foot sports performance space, with weight training equipment, training areas, and a full nutrition station. Plus, you can also access 3 gymnasiums with basketball courts, racquetball/wallyball courts, an indoor track, and several badminton/pickleball courts.

Laboratory
SUU has several labs in the College of Health Sciences, Computer Science, and the Natural Sciences. You’ll also find specialised labs like the Nutrition Assessment lab, the Foods lab, the Exercise Physiology lab, the Networking/Security lab, and more.

Cafeteria
You can find different dining options on campus. You can explore various dishes at the T-Bird Eats Dining Hall, and also get quick eats and beverages from multiple retail outlets on campus.
